summary: Examples of win_splitdrive on local and UNC paths, using first and last to get just the drive or the remaining path.
questions: How do I get just C: from a Windows path?
How do I strip the drive letter from a Windows path?

answer_card.title: win_splitdrive examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
{{ mypath | win_splitdrive }}          # 'C:\Users\asdf\foo.txt' -> ['C:', '\Users\asdf\foo.txt']
{{ mypath | win_splitdrive | first }}  # 'C:'
{{ mypath | win_splitdrive | last }}   # '\Users\asdf\foo.txt'

# UNC '//host/computer/dir/a'
{{ mypath | win_splitdrive | first }}  # '//host/computer'
{{ mypath | win_splitdrive | last }}   # '/dir/a'
```
